notes: Both לִי and לוֹ are fused with their suffixes, since the ASV writes *mine* and *his* and spends no word on the preposition's own relation; the construction's copula joins each fused unit, headed on the morpheme carrying the lexeme (rules 30, 49).
The italic *his flock* is added: no object morpheme stands in the clause, and dropping the phrase leaves *feedeth* still carrying the participle's lexeme (rules 7, 44).
The substantival article takes the supplied *He* and heads on it (rule 41), while the participle keeps its finite verb.
